modules.name: Core HR
modules.summary: One record per employee, from offer letter to exit.
modules.headline: Every employee record in one place, always current
modules.intro: Profiles, documents, reporting lines and job history live in a single record that payroll, attendance and leave all read from. Change a designation once and every module sees it.

capabilities.title: Employee profiles
capabilities.text: Personal, job, bank and statutory details (PAN, UAN, ESIC number) with field-level access control.

capabilities.title: Org chart
capabilities.text: Reporting lines, departments, locations and cost centres that update as people move.

capabilities.title: Document vault
capabilities.text: Offer letters, ID proofs and policies stored against each employee, with expiry reminders.

capabilities.title: Onboarding checklists
capabilities.text: Tasks for HR, IT and managers that start the day an offer is accepted.

capabilities.title: Exit management
capabilities.text: Resignation approval, notice period tracking, clearances and full-and-final settlement.

capabilities.title: Letters and templates
capabilities.text: Generate appointment, increment and experience letters from templates with merge fields.

workflow.title: Offer accepted
workflow.text: The candidate becomes an employee record with a joining date.

workflow.title: Joining day
workflow.text: Checklists go out to IT, admin and the reporting manager.

workflow.title: During employment
workflow.text: Transfers, promotions and salary revisions are logged with effective dates.

workflow.title: Exit
workflow.text: Clearances and final settlement run from the same record.

faqs.question: Can we import our existing employee data?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can upload a spreadsheet using our template, and our onboarding team checks it with you before go-live.

faqs.question: Who can see salary and bank details?
faqs.answer: You decide. Access is set by role, so a manager can see their team's attendance without seeing anyone's salary.

modules.name: Payroll
modules.summary: Monthly payroll with PF, ESI, PT and TDS worked out for you.
modules.headline: Run payroll in an afternoon, with compliance already done
modules.intro: Attendance, leave and reimbursements flow into payroll automatically. Statutory deductions are calculated as you run it, and payslips and challans are ready the moment you lock the month.

capabilities.title: Flexible salary structures
capabilities.text: Define CTC components, allowances and formulas once and apply them by grade or location.

capabilities.title: Statutory deductions
capabilities.text: PF, ESI, professional tax, labour welfare fund and TDS calculated per state rules.

capabilities.title: Income tax declarations
capabilities.text: Employees declare investments and upload proofs; TDS adjusts for the rest of the year.

capabilities.title: Payslips
capabilities.text: Branded payslips published to the employee app with a notification on payday.

capabilities.title: Bank transfer files
capabilities.text: Download salary transfer files in your bank's format, ready to upload.

capabilities.title: Reports and challans
capabilities.text: PF ECR, ESI, PT and Form 16 data generated from the same run.

workflow.title: Inputs sync
workflow.text: Attendance, LOP days, overtime and approved claims are pulled in.

workflow.title: Review
workflow.text: Compare with last month and see every change explained line by line.

workflow.title: Lock the month
workflow.text: Payslips publish and bank files are generated.

workflow.title: File
workflow.text: Statutory reports are ready for upload to the government portals.

faqs.question: Do you handle arrears and mid-month joiners?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pro-rated salaries, arrears from back-dated revisions and loss of pay are handled in the regular run.

faqs.question: Can we run payroll for more than one company?
faqs.answer: Yes. Multiple legal entities can be managed from one account, each with its own statutory settings.

faqs.question: Is full-and-final settlement included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Leave encashment, gratuity, notice recovery and pending reimbursements are calculated in the settlement.

modules.name: Attendance
modules.summary: Clock-ins from web, mobile or biometric devices, with shifts and overtime.
modules.headline: Attendance that lands in payroll without a spreadsheet
modules.intro: Employees clock in from the app, the web or your existing biometric device. Shifts, late marks and overtime rules are applied as the day happens, so month-end is a review, not a reconstruction.

capabilities.title: Mobile clock-in
capabilities.text: Geo-fenced and selfie-based clock-in for field and remote teams.

capabilities.title: Biometric sync
capabilities.text: Pull punches from supported biometric devices on a schedule.

capabilities.title: Shifts and rosters
capabilities.text: Fixed, rotating and night shifts with weekly-off patterns per team.

capabilities.title: Rules engine
capabilities.text: Grace periods, late marks, half days and overtime calculated automatically.

capabilities.title: Regularisation
capabilities.text: Employees request corrections for missed punches; managers approve in one tap.

workflow.title: Clock in
workflow.text: From phone, browser or device.

workflow.title: Rules apply
workflow.text: Late marks, half days and overtime are calculated.

workflow.title: Corrections
workflow.text: Missed punches are regularised with manager approval.

workflow.title: Month close
workflow.text: Payable days are sent to payroll.

faqs.question: Which biometric devices are supported?
faqs.answer: Most common devices that can export punch data are supported. Tell us your model during the demo and we will confirm.

faqs.question: Does mobile clock-in work offline?
faqs.answer: Punches are stored on the phone and synced when the connection returns, with the original time preserved.

modules.name: Leave
modules.summary: Leave policies, balances and approvals that follow your rules.
modules.headline: Leave policies your team can read and the system enforces
modules.intro: Set up casual, sick, earned and any other leave type with accrual, carry-forward and encashment rules. Employees see their balance before they apply, and managers approve from the app.

capabilities.title: Policy builder
capabilities.text: Accrual monthly or yearly, carry-forward caps, probation rules and sandwich rules.

capabilities.title: Holiday calendars
capabilities.text: Separate calendars by location, including optional holidays.

capabilities.title: Approvals
capabilities.text: Single or multi-level approval with delegation when a manager is away.

capabilities.title: Team calendar
capabilities.text: Managers see who is away before approving a request.

capabilities.title: Encashment
capabilities.text: Encashable leave flows into payroll or full-and-final settlement.

workflow.title: Apply
workflow.text: Employee picks dates and sees the balance after the request.

workflow.title: Approve
workflow.text: Manager checks the team calendar and approves.

workflow.title: Balance updates
workflow.text: Accruals and deductions apply immediately.

workflow.title: Payroll
workflow.text: Loss of pay days reach payroll without re-entry.

faqs.question: Can different teams have different leave policies?
faqs.answer: Yes. Policies can be assigned by location, department, grade or employment type.

modules.name: Expenses
modules.summary: Reimbursement claims with receipts, limits and approvals.
modules.headline: Reimbursements paid with salary, not chased over email
modules.intro: Employees photograph a receipt and submit a claim. Limits by category and grade are checked automatically, and approved claims are added to the next payroll.

capabilities.title: Receipt capture
capabilities.text: Snap a bill from the app and attach it to a claim.

capabilities.title: Category limits
capabilities.text: Travel, food, fuel and other categories with limits by grade.

capabilities.title: Advances
capabilities.text: Request a travel advance and settle it against claims later.

capabilities.title: Paid through payroll
capabilities.text: Approved claims are added to the next salary run.

workflow.title: Submit
workflow.text: Employee adds the receipt and category.

workflow.title: Check
workflow.text: Limits and duplicates are flagged before approval.

workflow.title: Approve
workflow.text: Manager and finance approve in turn.

workflow.title: Reimburse
workflow.text: The amount appears on the next payslip.

faqs.question: Can finance approve after the manager?
faqs.answer: Yes. Approval chains can include as many steps as your policy needs.

modules.name: Recruitment
modules.summary: Job openings, candidate pipelines and offers.
modules.headline: Hire from one pipeline instead of five inboxes
modules.intro: Publish openings, collect applications and move candidates through interview stages your team agrees on. When someone accepts an offer, they become an employee record without retyping anything.

capabilities.title: Job openings
capabilities.text: Create openings with approval from the hiring manager and finance.

capabilities.title: Careers page
capabilities.text: A careers page on your domain that lists open roles.

capabilities.title: Pipeline stages
capabilities.text: Drag candidates through screening, interviews and offer.

capabilities.title: Interview feedback
capabilities.text: Scorecards from each interviewer collected in one place.

capabilities.title: Offer letters
capabilities.text: Generate offers from templates and track acceptance.

workflow.title: Open a role
workflow.text: Hiring manager raises a request.

workflow.title: Source
workflow.text: Applications arrive from the careers page and referrals.

workflow.title: Interview
workflow.text: Panels submit scorecards after each round.

workflow.title: Offer
workflow.text: Accepted offers create the employee record.

faqs.question: Can interviewers give feedback without an HR login?
faqs.answer: Yes. Interviewers get a link to the candidate and the scorecard for their round.

modules.name: Performance
modules.headline: Reviews built on goals people actually tracked
modules.intro: Set goals at the start of a cycle, update progress through the year, and run reviews that draw on that record rather than on memory.

capabilities.title: Goals and OKRs
capabilities.text: Company, team and individual goals that roll up.

capabilities.title: Check-ins
capabilities.text: Regular one-on-one notes between managers and reports.

capabilities.title: Review cycles
capabilities.text: Self, manager and peer reviews on your schedule.

capabilities.title: Calibration
capabilities.text: Compare ratings across teams before they are final.

capabilities.title: Increments
capabilities.text: Approved revisions flow into payroll with an effective date.

workflow.title: Set goals
workflow.text: At the start of the cycle.

workflow.title: Check in
workflow.text: Progress and notes through the year.

workflow.title: Review
workflow.text: Self, manager and peer feedback.

workflow.title: Revise pay
workflow.text: Increments reach payroll.

faqs.question: Can we use our own rating scale?
faqs.answer: Yes. Rating scales, competencies and review questions are configurable for each cycle.

modules.name: Employee app
modules.summary: Payslips, leave and clock-in on every employee's phone.
modules.headline: Answers employees can find themselves
modules.intro: The employee app on Android and iOS lets people clock in, apply for leave, download payslips and submit tax declarations, which takes most routine questions off HR's desk.

capabilities.title: Payslips and Form 16
capabilities.text: Download any month's payslip or the annual Form 16.

capabilities.title: Leave and attendance
capabilities.text: Apply for leave, check balances and regularise punches.

capabilities.title: Tax declarations
capabilities.text: Declare investments and upload proofs from the phone.

capabilities.title: Company directory
capabilities.text: Find colleagues, their team and how to reach them.

capabilities.title: Announcements
capabilities.text: Policy updates and notices sent to everyone or one team.

workflow.title: Invite
workflow.text: Employees get a login link by email or SMS.

workflow.title: Sign in
workflow.text: On the app or the web.

workflow.title: Self-serve
workflow.text: Leave, payslips and declarations without asking HR.

faqs.question: Does the app work in regional languages?
faqs.answer: Tell us which languages your workforce needs during the demo and we will share what is available.
